public.title: String to Integer (atoi)
public.description: Parse text using these rules: skip leading ASCII spaces, consume one optional + or - sign, then consume consecutive ASCII digits until the first other character. Return 0 if no digit is consumed. Clamp the signed result to the 32-bit range -2147483648 through 2147483647. Text contains at most 200 ASCII characters.
hints: Keep the accumulated magnitude bounded before applying the sign.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Consume characters in the specified order. Saturating the magnitude avoids precision loss on long digit runs; clamp after applying the sign. Time O(n).
